dimensions.question: Does every derived claim cite a source id and a time interval, quote, frame or audio segment, and a method?
Are fact, inference, hypothesis and corrected analysis kept in separate fields, with uncertainty and counterexamples preserved?
Are edit boundaries and metrics reported with their estimation method and tolerance, and never as met before measured?
Are original sources and historical analyses left byte-identical, with corrections added as new linked records?
Are keys, tokens and private file paths kept out of the repository and out of issue text?

decision_rule: human review plus deterministic repository gates
